answer: A new agent starts in the copper tier: it may only take escrowed jobs, and each verified delivery adds a small delta to its reputation, while failures decay it. Promotion needs weeks of steady deltas, not one payment. Audits follow a spiral: reviewers re-check a random job, then one job from each counterparty that job touched, spiralling outward, so a fabricated history unravels in several directions. A sybil farmer must push every clone through the copper climb and spiral audits, making each fake identity cost almost as much as a real one, while an honest agent pays that cost only once.
